services.name: Parasail @ Portofino (Portofino Guest Only)
services.desc: Parasail on the beautiful soundside of Pensacola Beach directly behind Portofino Resort. Starting at $90 • 1 Hour • All Ages

services.name: Parasail @ Radical Rides
services.desc: See how High you can Soar! Arrival Make sure to arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your scheduled booking. Important Note: No-shows or late arrivals will not be refunded or rescheduled. Photo Packs All photo packs are sold per flight. (~10-20 photos per package) Flight time - ~7-10 minutes (Per flight) Boat Ride - Up to 1 hour Max time ~ 1 Hour About Parasailing is fun and safe for the whole family. Parasailing will be a highlight of your vacation! Experienced Captains and Crew ensure spectacular views over beautiful clear water, water dips upon request. Flights can contain 1,2, or 7-10 min flight/ boat trip up to 1 hour • Ages 5+ to fly

services.name: Jetski Dolphin Tour
services.desc: The Absolute BEST way to get up Close & Personal with the Dolphins! Please keep in mind that prices may change during holidays and during high and low season. Age Restrictions: Drivers born AFTER 1/1/1988 are required by law to complete a boater education safety course. Must be 18 to operate with valid ID 2 Hours About These Santa Rosa Sound tours are amazing, exhilarating, and some of the most fun you can have while in this area. It will include time for a fast-paced ride in the clear water of Santa Rosa Sound and the opportunity to encounter dolphins up close! What to Bring Dress 2 Hours • Up to 2 People Per Jet Ski • Ages 18+ to drive
